_comment: Mid-tier case study (5 conversations touching the ruling, spanning two weeks). Built the same way as case_study_decisions_0017.json.
ruling_title_in_decisions_md: Persona / LLM inference is a separate, pluggable service, never inside the toolkit wall
census_method: scan_all_decisions.py --root against the 2026-08-18 backup; 0018 hit 5 conversations, 30 mentions total

timeline.event: number proposed as the start of a new decisions block for the Command Deck design
timeline.speaker: assistant
timeline.quoted_substring: decide what the deck *is*. Want me to fold your rulings into a DECISIONS-style addendum (0018+) for the deck, or straight into a build brief once you've called 1 and 2?
timeline.note: At this point 0018 is not yet a specific ruling -- it's a placeholder for 'whatever comes next after 0017', and the same message flags that 0017 itself was still a draft.

timeline.speaker: assistant
timeline.quoted_substring: ## 0018 -- Persona / LLM inference is a separate, pluggable service, never inside the toolkit [wall]
timeline.note: Same conversation as seq 1, ~20 minutes later. Numbering assumed 0017 would land first; the thread explicitly flags 0017 was still a draft at this point.

timeline.event: used same-day as an established constraint to scope a different design question (where the inference service lives on disk)
timeline.speaker: assistant
timeline.quoted_substring: the gaming rig only, with the deck backend/UI and the vertex-3-derived inference service (0018) as projects under it. There's no Command Deck repo on disk yet
timeline.note: Different conversation from seq 1/2, same day -- shows the ruling being treated as settled and load-bearing within hours of being drafted, before it was formally logged.

timeline.event: audited as part of the '0016->0018 gap' discovery that also surfaced 0017's missing ratification
timeline.speaker: assistant
timeline.quoted_substring: The Command Deck | DECISIONS 0018-0023 -- six accepted entries: pluggable inference service outside the wall, structur[al...]
timeline.note: This is the SAME conversation and the same audit pass that discovers DECISIONS jumps 0016->0018 with no 0017 in the log (see case_study_decisions_0017.json seq 4) -- 0018 and 0017's stories physically intersect here. 0018 itself is confirmed as one of the entries that DID land, unlike 0017.

timeline.event: referenced two days later as part of a larger unbuilt roadmap
timeline.speaker: user
timeline.quoted_substring: The Command Deck mesh roadmap -- 0022 run ledger, 0021 supervisor, 0023 TOTP gate, 0018/0019 personas and inference. All specced at decision level, none briefed.
timeline.note: Confirms 0018 is ratified-but-unbuilt as of this date -- 'specced, not briefed' is a distinct status from both 'drafted' and 'executed.'

timeline.event: cited nearly two weeks later as settled precedent to answer a new architectural question
timeline.speaker: assistant
timeline.quoted_substring: Already ruled: 0018 (separate pluggable service) + 0019 (read-only handle). The extract arrives two weeks[...]
timeline.note: 13 days after seq 2. This is the clearest 'ruling as reusable precedent' moment in the arc -- a new design question gets resolved by pointing back at 0018 rather than re-litigating it.

cross_check_against_decisions_md.decisions_md_states: Persona / LLM inference is a separate, pluggable service, never inside the toolkit wall
cross_check_against_decisions_md.transcript_evidence: Consistent throughout all six events -- content matches DECISIONS.md's title almost verbatim from the moment it's drafted (seq 2) onward. No contradiction found.
cross_check_against_decisions_md.note: Unlike 0017, this ruling landed cleanly on its first attempt (part of the same 0018-0023 block) -- its story is about a ruling being drafted, immediately relied upon, then reused as precedent, not about a ruling going missing.

why_this_is_a_good_benchmark_item: It genuinely spans 5 conversations and 14 days, with a clean drafted -> relied-upon -> audited -> referenced-as-precedent arc -- a good mid-volume complexity target.

Its story physically intersects with 0017's at seq 4, in the same conversation and even the same status table -- a model given both case studies should notice the overlap rather than treating them as unrelated.

It distinguishes three different maturity states a ruling can be in (drafted, specced-but-unbuilt, used-as-precedent) at different points in the same short window -- testing whether a model tracks status transitions accurately rather than treating 'mentioned' as a single undifferentiated state.
